author: Anna Heim
title: Almost 80 European deep tech university spinouts reached $1B valuations or $100M in revenue in 2025 | TechCrunch
description: According to Dealroom’s European Spinout Report 2025, 76 European deep tech and life sciences spinouts have either reached $1 billion valuations, $100 million in revenue, or both.
content:
Universities and research labs have long been Europes deep tech treasure trove. Now, academic spinouts have consolidated into a solid startup funnel worth $398 billion and VC money is following.
